I don't quite understand what you mean, the analysis shows the solution you ask for. If you ask for the parsimonious solution, it will show the parsimonious solution.
If you ask for the intermediate solution, it will only show the intermediate solution (but not the complex, nor the parsimonious).

It will only show one type of solution, at a time.
Can you please clarify what is it exactly you are asking for? Also, if you have a concrete example, it would be good to construct (as per the instructions on this Google group) a so called minimal reproducible example.

All the best,
